title: U.S. tariffs take effect on India, threatening $48.2B in exports
summary: Earlier this month President Trump signed an executive order imposing an additional 25% tariff on India due its purchases of Russian oil, bringing the combined tariffs to 50%.

title: Whistleblower says Trump officials copied millions of Social Security numbers
summary: A whistleblower complaint says the personal data of over 300 million Americans was copied to a private cloud account to allow access by former members of the Department of Government Efficiency team.
